translation_notes: RDF.type / PROF.Profile become rdf:type / prof:Profile; the region is a read-only traversal, so those two terms are the whole of the notation change

the source's 14-name 'from rdflib.namespace import (...)' is namespace scaffolding for the whole 1000-line file: it is replaced by the two @prefix declarations the region actually uses (declaring the other twelve would be dead weight)
the draft placed the @prefix lines inside the parenthesised import list, which is not a statement position; they are moved out

the membership test 'p_ in ONTOLOGY_PROPS' is a Python list of URIRefs assembled in another module - nothing ldpy can express: a prefix declaration is not a runtime object, so the vocabulary list still has to be built with Namespace attribute access in rdf_elements
context shim: rdf_elements.py reproduces the four names the region imports from pylode.rdf_elements (verbatim from the corpus checkout); imported identically by both sides
driver: the Query object is stood in for by a SimpleNamespace holding the graph, since the region only touches self.graph
